title: Jensen bound for powers of the noise operator
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $T_\rho$ denote the noise operator with parameter $\rho \in [0,1]$ acting on Boolean functions $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$. Then for every real exponent $s \ge 1$ and every point $x \in \{0,1\}^n$,
\[
  \abs{(T_\rho f)(x)}^{s} \;\le\; \sum_{y \in \{0,1\}^n} K_\rho(x,y)\,\abs{f(y)}^{s},
\]
where $K_\rho(x,y) = \prod_{i} \tfrac{1 + \rho\,\sigma(x_i)\,\sigma(y_i)}{2}$ is the noise kernel of $\rho$-correlated pairs.
hypotheses_covered: f a Boolean function of arity n
x a point of the cube
